title: Accept an exact-pair controller transaction independently of unrelated parent smoke failures

implemented: The frontend release controller still requires the exact Pantheon nonprod workflow, repository, workflow_dispatch event, dev branch, and backend SHA before it accepts a transaction.
An active controller and an overall-success controller retain their prior acceptance behavior.
A completed parent with conclusion=failure is accepted only when its single exact job named 'Admit and switch exact FE/BFF release' completed successfully on the same run attempt.

The immutable release candidate remains authenticated before controller ownership is evaluated, including its release-candidate ID, compatibility-manifest digest, controller run ID, frontend SHA, and backend SHA.
not_changed: Pantheon nonprod deployment workflow behavior or its OpenClaw smoke checks.
Release-candidate admission generation, immutable artifact verification, deployment profiles, write authorization, credential handling, or environment configuration.
The bounded write-proof watchdog and read-only restoration contract.
fail_closed: A non-Pantheon repository, wrong workflow path, non-dispatch event, non-dev branch, or wrong backend head is rejected even if a coordination job reports success.
A parent failure without exactly one successful exact-pair coordination job is rejected.
Completed controller outcomes other than success or the narrowly accepted failure-plus-coordination case remain rejected.

deploy_dev.name: Deploy dev under shared environment lease
deploy_dev.context: The parent job includes unrelated post-deploy OpenClaw smoke coverage.

exact_pair_coordination.name: Admit and switch exact FE/BFF release
exact_pair_coordination.evidence: The job's 'Dispatch exact frontend gate and switch' and terminal accepted-or-compensated outcome steps both succeeded.

blocked_frontend_run.observation: The deploy job failed before the bounded proof coordinator; the proof coordinator and restore-confirmation jobs were skipped.

reproduction.diagnosis: The old ownership check accepted only active or overall-success parent runs. It therefore rejected the verified completed exact-pair transaction solely because the parent carried an unrelated smoke failure.

delivery.review_evidence_binding: This committed manifest must be bound by the independent Claude review to the exact pushed PR head before owner closeout.

contract_cases: unrelated parent smoke failure with successful exact-pair coordination accepts
failed or absent exact-pair coordination rejects

review.required_decision: Verify the exact reviewed head retains the narrow completed-failure exception, confirms exact-pair job identity and success, and does not weaken any write or credential guard.
